newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy H1 97 PSBR to fall more than 50 pct-Ciampi.
newsitem.headline: Italy H1 97 PSBR to fall more than 50 pct-Ciampi.

text.p: Italy's public sector borrowing requirement in the first half of 1997 is expected to fall by more than 50 percent compared with the same period of 1996, Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Monday.

The first half 1996 PSBR was 52.250 trillion lire. Ciampi told the lower house of parliament that forecasts "lead us to estimate that we will end the semester with a figure that is certainly inferior to half of the first semester of 1996".

Italy is committed to reducing the ratio between its budget deficit and gross domestic product to the three percent target for first wave membership of Europe's planned single currency from 6.7 percent in 1996.
